000.$description: The square corner for tables and technical UI.

100.$description: The corner radius for chips and badges.

200.$description: Radius scale step between smallElements and default. No semantic token maps it directly.

300.$description: The standard corner radius for controls and content containers.

400.$description: Radius scale step between default and largeElements. No semantic token maps it directly.

500.$description: The corner radius for modals and hero content containers.

600.$description: Brand radius step 600, six times the UI base scale.

700.$description: Brand radius step 700, eight times the UI base scale.

800.$description: Brand radius step 800, ten times the UI base scale.

default.$description: Brand-selected default corner radius; choose a numeric radius primitive or none.

full.$description: The fully rounded pill or circle for avatars and notifications.

insetMinimum.$description: The minimum radius of corners inset inside a padded surface; set to the none radius for strictly concentric corners.

largeElements.$description: Brand-selected corner radius for large elements; choose a numeric radius primitive or none.

none.$description: No corner rounding. Keeps the zero-radius primitive available through an explicit brand selector.

smallElements.$description: Brand-selected corner radius for small elements; choose a numeric radius primitive or none.

100.$description: The stroke width of selected elements.

200.$description: The stroke width of focus outlines.
